findings.summary: Of the 1061 weaker cells that no due row asks for, most map to an intended relaxation kind (K1–K11). Ten do not: `== NO KIND | egress-guard | cells 1 | commands 1` and `== NO KIND | secret-shell | cells 9 | commands 3` (line 23). These are verdicts weaker than 0.8.0 that no decided relaxation explains. SUMMARY.md:26 presents this file as 'every verdict that is weaker than at 0.8.0, by the kind that asks for it', which does not cover them. Name the 4 commands and the decision that allows them, or fix the guard.

The replay of 45 days of recorded calls exits 1 ('replay exit 1 (0: nothing weaker, 1: something weaker)'), with 'weaker: 2 occurrences' for the own boundary. The client boundary has 'weaker: 18' (line 35). The detail confirms both: `secret-shell | ask | 22 | 20` (line 53) and `egress-guard | ask | 30 | 14` (line 63). SUMMARY.md:39 describes the file only as totals per rule and does not say that real-world verdicts got weaker, or which relaxation each one belongs to. Map these 20 cells to their relaxation kinds, or say in the summary where they are recorded.

All five fresh-review receipts in the folder are COMMENT with open MAJOR findings. The run on the final head has no receipt here, and its verdict lives only in the PR text and on the owner's machine. The gap is disclosed, but this folder alone does not show the clean fresh review the merge rule needs.
The capture entries record command, exit code and tool version, but no git commit. The claim that lint and suite ran at `35cac75` (SUMMARY.md:25) has no machine-written record behind it.
The 'other context, per id' list breaks off mid-entry ('... U4 4, X'). The evidence line is incomplete, so the per-id counts of other-context weaker cells cannot be checked.

The placeholder `<SCRATCH>/eng3/table_match.py` is not in the path legend of SUMMARY.md:47-49 (`<WT>`, `<S8>`, `<ORCH>`, `<PAD>`, `<PAD2>`, `<HK>`, `<MAIN>`, `<HOME>`). The `SC/eng/...` paths in engineers/01 and 02 and the partial worktree name `…/g090-bc/` are not explained either.

summary: This diff adds evidence files only: check outputs, engineer and reviewer reports, fresh-review receipts and SHA256SUMS. No code or test changes, and every file is listed in SHA256SUMS. I found no secrets, credentials or hostnames. Owner paths are replaced with placeholders, though one is missing from the legend. Nothing blocks the merge, but the evidence shows weaker verdicts that it does not explain. Ten weaker cells against 0.8.0 have no relaxation kind. The replay of real calls exits 1 with 2 weaker cells in the own boundary and 18 in the client boundary, and SUMMARY.md says neither. Smaller gaps: no receipt shows a fresh review with no open finding on the final head (disclosed); the captures do not record the commit they ran at; one output line is cut off.
